items.title: Magma Forge
steps: Place the Forge Core at the center of a flat 3×3 platform.
Place a casing on each of its four cardinal sides and an Energy Unit at each corner.
Right-click the center core to validate and form the forge.
details: Use the formed forge for alloy recipes and the tempering minigame. Press Space in the green zone for a Perfect Strike.
The eight outer blocks become forge dummy blocks when formed.
rules: Corners also accept Basic Energy Cells or Energy Cores. Edges accept Basic or Advanced Volcanite Casings. The diagram uses a recommended combination.

items.title: Volcanite Energy Matrix
steps: Place an Energy Core at the center.
Fill the eight surrounding positions on the same Y level. Use at least four Energy Cells or Units; fill the rest with valid cells, units or casings.
The matrix evaluates its structure automatically. Open the core to inspect its status and stored energy.
details: Use the matrix as shared RF storage; additional cells or units increase its capacity.
rules: All eight ring positions must be occupied by valid blocks. Basic and Advanced Volcanite Casings are accepted. The cells do not have to be on the four sides shown here.

items.title: Keraunos HV Matrix
steps: Place the HV Core at the center of a full 3×3×3 cube.
Fill all 26 surrounding positions with valid shell blocks. Include at least one Keraunos HV Port.
The structure validates automatically. Connect your network through its ports and inspect the core GUI.
details: Formed capacity starts at 1 billion RF. Each Basic Cell adds 150 million RF; each Advanced Unit adds 600 million RF.
Consult the HV Safety chapter before operating the high-voltage system.
rules: The diagram is one valid example, not a fixed pattern. Shell blocks may be Basic/Advanced Casings, Volcanite/Supreme Volcanite Glass, Reinforced Tinted Glass, Cells, Units or HV Ports. No air gaps are allowed.

items.title: Olympian Hadron Collider
steps: Place the controller at the middle of a side of the 5×5 perimeter.
Complete the perimeter with 12 coils and one port of each type, as illustrated. Leave the inner 3×3 clear.
Open the controller GUI. Use Holo 5×5 for guidance or Auto-Build with the required components in your inventory.
Supply energy, fuel, coolant and collision ingredients through the GUI or ports. Reach at least 30% c before triggering a collision.
details: Collisions can produce Singularity Hadron Alloy probabilistically. The primary alloy roll has a 10% chance.
Keep out of the inner region during operation: the controller has a radiation hazard.
rules: The standard manual layout uses 12 coils. Current validation accepts at least nine coils, at least one Energy/Item/Fluid Port each, and valid ring members in every remaining perimeter position. Keep the interior air for the recommended build.

items.title: Tartarus Piston Engine
steps: Build the two full layers shown: one Basic Volcanite Generator and seven Advanced Casings.
Right-click a structure component with the Volcanite Wrench to assemble it.
Open the formed engine, supply a supported fuel and cooling, then choose its operating mode.
details: Cooling controls engine temperature; the manual recommends ice, snow, water or Bio-Ethanol.
Shift-right-click with the wrench dismantles the formed engine.
rules: This is the recommended layout. The validator accepts Basic or Advanced Casings and one or more Basic Volcanite Generators, with all eight positions filled.

items.title: Dionysian Bio-Caldera
steps: Build a full cube with one Demetrian Biomass Generator, one Reinforced Liquid Barrel and six Advanced Casings.
Right-click a structure component with the Volcanite Wrench to assemble it.
Open the formed controller and provide inputs for the Bio-Caldera processing chain.
details: Shift-right-click with the wrench dismantles the formed structure.
rules: The diagram is the recommended manual build. Current validation is more permissive: all eight blocks must be valid, with at least one Biomass Generator, Reinforced Liquid Barrel or Volcanic Wood Liquid Barrel; the remaining positions may be Basic or Advanced Casings.

items.title: Mega Volcanic Barrel
steps: Build a full 2×2×2 cube from one Reinforced Liquid Barrel and seven Basic Volcanite Casings.
Right-click a component with a Dionysian Barrel Core. Alternatively, use the wrench while carrying one core in your inventory. The core is consumed in survival.
Use the formed structure for large fluid storage.
details: Assembly preserves compatible fluids from the original barrels. Shift-wrench dismantles the structure; empty it first when reorganizing your storage.
rules: At least one Reinforced Liquid Barrel is required. Additional reinforced barrels are accepted in place of casings. Advanced Casings are not valid for this structure.

items.title: Poseidon Abyssal Pump
steps: Place the pump controller at a bottom corner.
Facing north, the structure extends west and south from the controller, with a second layer above. Fill the other seven positions with Abyssal Casings. Rotate this footprint with controller facing.
Open the pump GUI and use its hologram or Auto-Build to place the casings in the exact positions. Auto-Build consumes inventory casings and skips obstructed spaces.
Supply RF and select the pumping mode and speed.
details: Available target rates are 1,000 / 4,000 / 16,000 mB per tick. Operation also depends on available fluid, energy and output capacity.
The structure validates automatically; breaking a required casing unforms it.
rules: Only Poseidon Abyssal Casings are valid. The footprint is orientation-dependent; do not build an arbitrary cube on the opposite side of the controller.

items.title: Olympian Ritual Altar
steps: Place the altar in the center and four Astrape Ritual Obelisks three blocks away to the north, east, south and west.
Place the item to bind on the altar and a Mythic Scroll on an obelisk.
Right-click the altar with an empty hand to attempt the ritual. Meet the selected pact’s weather, time and item conditions.
details: This ritual structure does not transform into a solid machine shell. Shift-right-click the altar with an empty hand to retrieve its item when no ritual is running.
rules: The cross is the recommended manual example. Current code searches offsets X/Z −4…+4 and Y −1…+1, excluding the altar column, and requires at least four obelisks. Diagonals and uneven ground are supported; exactly three blocks and identical Y are not mandatory.
